label: VO

notes.grounding: Claims about the script match: unconditional final exit 0, Overall Completion from OVERALL_PERCENTAGE, --file percentage sourced from stats, NOT FOUND branch, EXIT trap, bc guard, trailing exit-code comment listing only 1, the vitest file with exactly two cases, and exit 3 meaning system error in validate.sh. One mechanical claim is wrong: ${2:-} does not make a trailing --min-percent a usage error, because shift 2 with one argument left fails and errexit exits 1 silently (confirmed by running the pattern under set -euo pipefail).
notes.requirements: REQ-001..006 are testable and cover exit 3 below N, exit 0 at or above N (inclusive), byte-identical text and JSON output, missing/non-integer/out-of-range values exit 1 with stderr and empty stdout, and --file mode.
notes.verification: No task ends with a Verify: clause naming a command and its expected output. T014 and T015 say run vitest and diff, but name no command line or expected output; T001-T009 carry no check at all. The planned test cases themselves would catch a wrong implementation, which keeps this above 1.
notes.scope: Stays on the one option at Level 1 with the script and its test file; no invented subsystem, no unfilled token. The exit-3 collision risk and help-text update are relevant, not filler.
notes.consistency: spec, plan and tasks agree on file paths, exit codes 3/0/1, the 0..100 bound, REQ ids, globals MIN_PERCENT and REPORTED_PERCENTAGE, and the test plan.
notes.clarity: A developer could implement directly from T004-T009. The one question left is the missing-value path: following T005 literally produces a silent exit 1 with no option-naming message, so REQ-004 and T012 would fail without a guard the packet does not describe.
